segments.text:
Hello everyone, I am Zach Peterson
and I wanted to let you all know

that we are currently running a business
card design contest.

We've already received
some great submissions

from folks out there in the audience,
but if you're out there watching

and you have a great idea for a business
card PCB, we want to hear from you.

And of course, if you actually manufacture
your business card, get it assembled

You can send it in to us
and we will show it on the channel.

Deadline for PCB business card
submissions is February

15th, and the winner
will get a box of Altium swag.

Check out these hoodies.
That's not all we got for you.

If you want to submit a design
for this contest, head over to LinkedIn

and send me a message
with your design files

and make sure to send in
your design by February 15th.

title: Enter Our PCB Business Card Design Contest and Win Altium Swag!
